messages:
customer_jordan: Hey team — onboarding SSO for acme-inc. After we configure the IdP metadata URL we get a 403 when the ACS posts to Redwood. Tried twice, same result. Can you help?

sam_support: Sorry about that. Can you paste the exact ACS URL you configured and the IdP metadata URL? Any error in the SAMLResponse (recipient/audience) would help.

customer_jordan: ACS we gave them: https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume
IdP metadata: https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata (when I curl it I see a 301 -> https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata/ )
We're seeing this in our app logs: 
```
SAML validation failed: Recipient mismatch. expected=https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume got=https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume/
Assertion signed by unknown key
```

sam_support: two things jump out: the trailing slash normalization and the cert. The Recipient has a trailing slash on the incoming assertion. Our ACS canonicalization expects the configured ACS exactly. Did you set the ACS with or without trailing slash in our console?

customer_jordan: We set it without the slash (https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume). Our IdP team insists their tool will always post with a trailing slash.

jess_sre: FYI our metadata fetcher follows redirects, but we recently tightened entityID extraction to prefer metadata's EntityDescriptor@entityID if present. If metadata URL redirects, some IdPs change entityID or canonicalize URLs which can cause mismatch.

sam_support: Can you confirm whether the IdP metadata's <AssertionConsumerService Location> includes the trailing slash? If their assertion is signed by a cert we don't have (they rotated signing cert yesterday per your note), our cached key might still be the old one.

customer_jordan: I looked — the metadata at the trailing-slash URL contains ACS with slash. The top-level metadata at the non-slash URL redirects to the slash. The metadata lists two KeyDescriptor entries; the signing cert (sha1 thumbprint) changed yesterday.

natalie_pm: tagging for visibility — this is a common onboarding pain. Docs should call out that IdP endpoints must not redirect (or should match configured entity IDs). We should also consider adding a tolerant match for trailing slash during onboarding. :thinking_face:

jess_sre: For immediate unblocking: sam_support, I can force-refresh the metadata for acme tenant if you give me the tenant ID. That will pull the new cert and the canonical ACS. There's a small window where the IdP could still sign with the old key, so we'll keep both keys for 15 minutes.

sam_support: tenant ID is acme-7842. customer_jordan, do you consent to us forcing a metadata refresh and temporarily accepting both certs?

customer_jordan: Yes please. We need this in next hour.

deploybot: metadata-refresh-runner: started refresh for tenant=acme-7842 by=jess_sre

deploybot: metadata-refresh-runner: fetched https://idp.acme.com/saml/metadata/ (followed 1 redirect). Found 2 KeyDescriptor(s). Applied new signing cert, kept previous for 15m grace period. Updated cached ACS to https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume/

sam_support: Ok, we forced a grace period to accept both versions and aligned the cached ACS to the one in metadata (with trailing slash). You should immediately try sign-in again. If you prefer, we can canonicalize on our side to strip trailing slashes for matching, but need product sign-off.

customer_jordan: Tried it — success! Logged in, no 403. Thanks. Logs now show Recipient https://acme.redwood.ai/saml/consume/ which matches metadata.

natalie_pm: Action items: 1) Docs update: recommend configuring ACS exactly as in metadata and avoid redirects, 2) Support playbook: add a checklist for idp metadata redirects + cert rotation, 3) Product: consider permissive ACS matching toggle for onboarding.

jess_sre: I'll open infra ticket to add a diagnostic to the metadata fetcher that flags redirects and surfaces them in support UI. Also adding an admin button to force-refresh tenant metadata.

sam_support: Marking thread resolved for now. If the IdP rotates certs frequently, we can enable automatic short-lived multi-cert acceptance. :thumbsup:

customer_jordan: Thanks all! Especially jess_sre and sam_support. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
